overview_description.description: Dexter provides consultancy services to small and medium-sized enterprises across finance, business planning, company formation, legal contracts, mergers and acquisitions, exit planning, and IT development. Its finance work covers business plans, financial forecasts, capital raising, structured finance, and related advisory activities. Dexter supports company registrations for limited companies and LLPs and assists with commercial and financial legal documents. Its M&A services include transaction planning, target screening, financial evaluation, and related commercial assistance. The company also advises business owners on succession and exit planning and supports complex IT projects involving websites, technology structures, and development.

product.name: Mergers & Acquisitions

product.name: Exit Planning

product.name: IT Development
